LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryWar: Start a war with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryOfferPeace: Offer terms to end the current war.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryDemandPeace: Demand terms to end the current war.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummarySwear: Become this House's vassal and recognize them as your liege.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryDemandOath: Demand that this House become your vassal.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryOfferSilver: Offer immediate silver or daily tribute.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryDemandSilver: Ask this House for silver or daily tribute.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryOfferLevies: Lend soldiers from your holdings for a fixed term.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryDemandLevies: Request soldiers to garrison your holdings for a fixed term.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryOfferLand: Cede one eligible holding to this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryDemandLand: Ask this House to cede one eligible holding.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryTrade: Establish scheduled trade caravans between your Houses.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummarySupplyJob: Deliver recurring supplies to this House for payment.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryAttackJob: Attack a settlement belonging to a shared enemy.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryTrial: Settle the dispute through two chosen champions.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryPrisoners: Exchange or ransom named captives at a chosen settlement.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryRequestSettlers: Request abstract smallfolk households for one of your holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryOfferSettlers: Offer abstract smallfolk households to this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryMarriage: Arrange a marriage or non-romantic betrothal.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummaryFoster: Arrange a temporary ward between the Houses.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionSummarySquire: Arrange temporary squire service between the Houses.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipOfferSilver: Silver is paid when the proposal is accepted. Daily tribute continues until the agreement ends; three missed payments cancel it.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipDemandSilver: Their available treasury limits immediate payment. Daily tribute continues until the agreement ends.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipOfferLevies: Lent soldiers leave their source holdings and workforce for the full term. Survivors return to those exact holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipDemandLevies: Hired soldiers fill available garrison capacity for the chosen term, then return to their House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipOfferLand: Only settled, idle holdings can be ceded. Ownership, population, development and surviving garrison strength transfer permanently.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipDemandLand: A House yields an eligible holding only under substantial value or military pressure. The transfer is permanent.
LanguageData.ARIO_DActionTipMigration: One migration may involve 1–3 households. Departure requires a caravan envoy and has a 20-day deadline followed by a 30-day House cooldown; new villages require three households.
LanguageData.ARIO_DDealPeaceExplanation: Propose an end to this war. Select other actions to add concessions or demands to the same proposal. Offer Peace and Demand Peace use the same acceptance rules: the complete bargain determines whether the other House agrees. Demanding peace does not guarantee acceptance.
LanguageData.ARIO_DDealMarriageMode: Arrangement: {0}. Younger pairs use a political contract only; adults may also choose to keep it political. A romantic spouse relationship and travel require both adults' willing reconfirmation.
LanguageData.ARIO_DDealWarExclusive: A declaration of war carries no other terms. Deselect it to bargain instead.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavClearConfirm: Discard the entire unsent proposal? Signed agreements are not affected.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavIncomplete: Select all required people, resources and destinations
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavAgreementOpen: View signed terms, deadlines and obligations
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavFeudalAttention: Taxes, banner service, supplies or a visiting liege
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavRelationshipsHelp: Click a portrait to explore that person's family. The helmet button changes their portrait only. The shields below show how other factions regard the selected House. Trade means friendly trading relations; signed caravan pacts and other agreements are listed separately.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavNoAgreements: No active agreements with this faction. Use Actions to propose one.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavAgreementEnded: This agreement has ended or is no longer available. Return to the agreement list for current terms.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavTributeStatus: You pay {0} silver/day · They pay {1} silver/day
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavReplaceConfirm: Replace the unsent proposal with a new action? Its current terms will be cleared. To combine terms instead, return to the draft and use Add/change terms.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavUnavailable: Unavailable with the current relationship or an existing agreement. Review Agreements for current commitments. Signing is revalidated before submission.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavActionsHelp: Select actions to combine their terms into one proposal. Deselecting a row removes its terms. War carries no other terms; primary actions are mutually exclusive. Choose one dynastic arrangement and one job type per proposal. The acceptance chance below covers the complete bargain.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavAddTerms: Edit a part of this proposal
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavOathHelp: You can serve only one liege. Oaths use the existing acceptance and Integrity rules. Promised silver, land or soldiers are additional terms, not replacements for the oath.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavPeaceHelp: Select Offer Peace or Demand Peace while at war, then add concessions or demands using the other action rows. All selected terms form a single negotiated peace proposal.
LanguageData.ARIO_DNavReviewHelp: Every selected term remains in this proposal even when its editor is not visible. Click a term to edit it; Remove clears only that term. The pinned acceptance reflects the complete package. Submission opens a final confirmation and revalidates current availability.
